notes: Ludum Dare 45 entry Super Colonize Bot (Katamari Damacy meets Factorio). Complete Unity 2019.1.0f2 project (Assets+ProjectSettings+Packages) with Title, Tutorial, and Main scenes, author-made sprites (including Paint.NET sources), and gameplay scripts (bots, resources, buildings, world generation). Unlicense. Official Unity packages only (2019.1 default template, TextMeshPro 2.0.0 as a package with no vendored fonts). UI uses Unity built-in default font only; no bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL/EXE, no audio. ~1.8M src snapshot.
